originalBody: If you already started it yesterday, today shows you if you still want it once the first burst wears off.
body: With the Moon in Aries, wanting something and acting on it can feel very close together. That directness can help you speak honestly about what matters to you. Impatience can also make a delay feel like a refusal, even when the answer is simply not yet.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: Repeat what actually made yesterday easier instead of adding more to the plan.
body: The Taurus Moon brings attention to comfort and the things that help you feel secure. A familiar routine can be reassuring, especially when you have a lot to manage. The same attachment to familiarity can make a useful change harder to consider.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The extra information is useful only if it changes the decision.
body: With the Moon in Gemini, talking through a feeling can help you understand it. A question or a different point of view may give you words for something you had trouble explaining. There is also room to change your mind as you learn more.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: Notice what you keep needing once the immediate mood passes.
body: The Cancer Moon brings attention to home, closeness, and the care you need. You may want the company of someone who knows you well, or more privacy than usual. Caring for someone and needing time to yourself can both be true.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The urgency starts to wear off once the Moon enters Taurus. You may care less about getting it done fast and more about making the plan something your body, budget, or schedule can actually support.
body: In Aries, the Moon emphasizes independence and the impulse to act. In Taurus, the focus turns toward comfort and security. You may feel more drawn to a familiar routine or an unhurried meal than to starting something new.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: What felt simple enough to leave alone can turn into a question once the Moon enters Gemini. You may want one more detail, another conversation, or a little more information before you decide.
body: The shift from Taurus to Gemini brings a different way of working through feelings: from seeking comfort in what is familiar to talking, asking questions, and hearing another point of view. Curiosity may make it easier to consider a possibility you had not thought of.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The conversation can keep moving until the Moon enters Cancer, when the part that actually bothered you becomes harder to talk around. You may want less input and more time to figure out how you feel about it.
body: As the Moon moves from Gemini to Cancer, attention turns from exchanging ideas toward emotional closeness and privacy. You may care more about feeling understood than finding an explanation for every feeling. Familiar company can be comforting; time alone may be just as welcome.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The Full Moon was yesterday. Keep the part that became clear. You do not need to turn the rest into a conclusion yet.
body: Yesterday was the [Full Moon in {{previousLunationSign}}]({{previousLunationUrl}}), on {{previousLunationDate}}. Full Moons are a point of reflection in the lunar cycle: a chance to notice what is developing in your life and how you feel about it. A realization may take time to understand; there is no requirement to make a decision today.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The Full Moon was {{daysSincePreviousLunation}} days ago. The first reaction has had some time to settle. Notice what still needs your attention now.
body: The [Full Moon in {{previousLunationSign}}]({{previousLunationUrl}}) was on {{previousLunationDate}}, {{daysSincePreviousLunation}} days ago. The waning phase that follows is associated with reflection and release. If that Full Moon brought a concern or a desire into focus, you can return to it with more time to consider what you need.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The light starts giving itself away. Tell someone what this cycle taught you; a lesson settles when it is shared.
body: The Moon is waning after the [Full Moon in {{previousLunationSign}} on {{previousLunationDate}}]({{previousLunationUrl}}). In astrology, this part of the cycle is associated with making sense of recent experiences. You may understand a feeling differently when you put it into words, whether in a conversation or a journal.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review

originalBody: The waning Moon carries things out. Put down what the harvest proved you no longer need.
body: The Last Quarter Moon falls between the [Full Moon in {{previousLunationSign}} on {{previousLunationDate}}]({{previousLunationUrl}}) and the [New Moon in {{nextLunationSign}} on {{nextLunationDate}}]({{nextLunationUrl}}). This phase is associated with reconsidering what you want to continue. If you have been working toward an intention, this is a chance to notice whether it still matters to you and whether your approach needs to change.
scope: Calendar Day and Week Moon passages, September 27–October 3 review
